implementation.root_cause: Profile names were truncated with String.slice(0, 32), which counts UTF-16 code units and could split a supplementary Unicode character at the boundary. Profiles imported by an older build could also contain the lone high surrogate left by that split.
implementation.fix: A shared code-point-aware truncation helper trims profile names, drops malformed lone surrogates from legacy values, and stops before exceeding the existing 32 UTF-16-code-unit limit. Import normalization, profile creation and rename use the same helper.
regression_cases: 31 ASCII characters followed by a supplementary emoji truncates before the emoji rather than persisting half of its surrogate pair.
31 ASCII characters followed by a legacy lone high surrogate normalize to the valid 31-character name.
The profile-name input displays the normalized imported name.
The profile flow produces zero Page Model, Save or Publish writes.
